title: A finite etale morphism is etale locally a finite disjoint union of copies of the base
statement: Let $f:Y\to X$ be a finite etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $x\in X$. Then there are an etale morphism $g:U\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], a point $u\in U$ with $g(u)=x$, a finite set $J$ and a decomposition $Y\times_XU=\coprod_{j\in J}V_j$ of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] into pairwise disjoint open and closed subschemes $V_j$ such that, for every $j\in J$, the composite $V_j\hookrightarrow Y\times_XU\xrightarrow{\mathrm{pr}_2}U$ is an isomorphism of schemes.

proof.text: Let P=(Y×_X U)×_U W and D_j=V_j×_(Y×_X U) P for j∈K, with a_j:D_j→P. The pullback range formula gives range a_j=pr₁⁻¹(range ι_j). The original coproduct cofan covers points and has disjoint component images, as shown by identifying its Sigma.desc with an isomorphism and using sigmaMk and sigmaι_eq_iff. Every point t of P lies in one original component j, and membership constancy on W implies j∈K. Hence the a_j cover P and are pairwise disjoint. They are open and closed by base change. Apply nonempty_isColimit_cofanMk_of to obtain their coproduct cofan.

proof.text: The composite r_j=a_j≫pr₂:D_j→W becomes, after composition with W.ι, the composite of the pullback projection D_j→V_j with p_j. Both factors are open immersions, so cancellation along W.ι makes r_j an open immersion. Given w∈W, membership constancy and j∈K give v∈V_j with p_j(v)=w. The scheme pullback point-lifting lemma gives t∈P over ι_j(v) and w; the range formula for a_j gives a preimage in D_j. Thus r_j is surjective and isIso_of_isOpenImmersion_of_opensRange_eq_top applies. Finally pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso identifies P with Y×_X W, compatibly with second projections. Transport the coproduct cofan along this isomorphism using Cofan.ext and IsColimit.ofIsoColimit. The map W.ι≫g is étale and carries the point (u,huW) to x.

lean.statement: theorem finite_etale_etale_local_split {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X) [IsFinite f] [Etale f] (x : X) : ∃ (U : Scheme.{u}) (g : U ⟶ X) (u : U), Etale g ∧ g.base u = x ∧ ∃ (J : Type u) (V : J → Scheme.{u}) (ι : ∀ j, V j ⟶ pullback f g), Finite J ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk (pullback f g) ι)) ∧ (∀ j, IsOpenImmersion (ι j) ∧ IsClosedImmersion (ι j)) ∧ (∀ j : J, ∃ e : V j ≅ U, e.hom = ι j ≫ pullback.snd f g)
